info.title: GECKO Platform API
info.description: Identity · TOS · Notification. Log in with POST /auth/login, then Authorize with the accessToken.

get.summary: Public keys of the access-token signer (JWKS)

post.summary: Exchange email (or user name) + password for an access token (+ refresh cookie)
post.description: `email` takes the e-mail or the user name, whichever the user has. Accounts are created by invitation; there is no self-service signup. A wrong email or user name and a wrong password all return the same 401.

post.summary: New access token from the refresh cookie; rotates the cookie
post.description: Uses the HttpOnly cookie set by /auth/login — Swagger UI sends it automatically. Presenting an already-rotated cookie revokes the whole session chain.

post.summary: Revoke the refresh cookie's session

get.summary: The claims in the caller's access token, and who the caller is (name, e-mail, user ID)

post.summary: Change your own password: new password + confirmation
post.description: Owner 2026-10-10: just the new password typed twice; the caller's access token proves who they are. The old password stops working at once; this session stays signed in.

Platform modules (TOS, EDI, NOTIFICATION, ...)

The auditor's search: every recorded action, newest first. Filters: from, to (ISO, to exclusive), module, userId, source, action (comma lists), entityType, entityId, ref, q, branchId; after + pageSize to page.
The same search as an Excel sheet (same filters), up to 20,000 rows; times in Thai time.
What the search can filter on: the modules, and the action codes each has recorded for this tenant (with counts).
Per module: the last ledger digest kept outside the database, the last ledger check, history retention, and how much of this tenant's history is archived.

post.summary: Proves the module's audit ledger was not altered: sys.sp_verify_database_ledger against every digest read back from the write-once store. A check within the last 10 minutes is returned instead of re-run.

get.summary: This tenant's archived history files (one per history table per month), newest month first. Filters: module, table (history.x), month (yyyy-MM-01).
Downloads one archived history file (Parquet; open with DuckDB, Python or Power BI). Restore-for-audit: docs/AUDIT_RESTORE.md.
